name: Mob Psycho 100
overview: Shigeo "Mob" Kageyama is a quiet boy with terrifying psychic power. He wants an ordinary life — but when his emotions spike past 100%, something catastrophic happens.

name: Wandance
overview: A stuttering high-schooler discovers freestyle dance and the classmate who moves through the world without caring what anyone thinks.

name: Doraemon
overview: A robotic cat is sent back from the 22nd century to rescue a lazy schoolboy from his own future — with gadgets that usually make things worse.

name: One Piece
overview: Monkey D. Luffy ate a Devil Fruit, gained a rubber body, and set sail to claim the legendary One Piece and become King of the Pirates.

name: Chibi Maruko-chan
overview: Maruko is a curious, occasionally lazy schoolgirl whose warm family and loyal friends turn everyday life into small adventures.

name: Bleach
overview: Ichigo Kurosaki can see ghosts. After a run-in with a Soul Reaper he inherits her powers and a duty: protect the living and the dead from Hollows.

name: Pokémon
overview: Ash and his Pikachu travel region after region, catching Pokémon, winning badges and chasing the title of Pokémon Master.

name: Detective Conan
overview: A teenage detective is shrunk by a poison and solves impossible cases from inside the body of a child, hunting the syndicate that did it.

name: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
overview: A century-long feud between the Joestar bloodline and the immortal Dio Brando, told generation by generation with impossible powers and immaculate poses.

name: JUJUTSU KAISEN
overview: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger to save a friend and shares his body with the King of Curses. Now he hunts curses at Tokyo Jujutsu High.

name: The Witch and the Beast
overview: A cursed woman and a soft-spoken man carrying a coffin cross a dark fantasy world hunting the witch who ruined her life.

name: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World-
overview: Subaru is pulled into another world where he can only survive by dying and restarting. Every save costs him something he can't get back.

name: Naruto Shippūden
overview: Naruto returns to Konoha after two and a half years of training, stronger and hunted by the Akatsuki.

name: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
overview: After the heroes defeat the Demon King, the elven mage Frieren outlives her companions and sets out to understand the mortals she barely knew.

name: Crayon Shin-chan
overview: Five-year-old Shinnosuke is a walking disaster with an adult's sense of humour and absolutely no shame.

name: Ranma ½
overview: A martial artist falls into a cursed spring: cold water turns him into a girl, hot water turns him back. His arranged fiancée is not amused.

name: Monster
overview: A brilliant Japanese surgeon saves a boy's life in Germany and spends years discovering exactly what he let loose on the world.

name: Lupin the 3rd
overview: The world's greatest thief, his marksman, his swordsman and a detective who never gives up — the original gentleman-thief caper series.

name: Spirited Away
overview: Chihiro stumbles into a world of spirits where her parents are transformed, and must find the courage she never knew she had to free them.

name: Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle
overview: The Corps is pulled into the Infinity Castle for the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji, where Tanjiro, Nezuko and the Hashira face the Upper Ranks.

name: Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising
overview: The fragile peace after Rebellion shatters as a new threat tied to Walpurgisnacht emerges, forcing Homura to face what she chose to protect Madoka.

name: Howl's Moving Castle
overview: Cursed into the body of an old woman, Sophie joins the wizard Howl in a walking castle and gets tangled in a war he refuses to fight.

name: Your Name.
overview: Two teenagers who have never met begin swapping bodies at random, and the search for each other becomes a race against a disaster only they can prevent.

name: Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc
overview: Denji meets Reze in the rain, and the deadliest fight of his life begins — fuelled by love in a world where survival has no rules.

name: Princess Mononoke
overview: Cursed by a demon boar, a prince travels west and finds himself between a forest of gods and the humans burning it down.

name: My Neighbor Totoro
overview: Two sisters move to the countryside and befriend the giant forest spirits living in the trees next door.

name: A Silent Voice
overview: A boy who bullied a deaf classmate spends years trying to atone — and finds that forgiveness is harder to give himself than to receive.

name: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
overview: In a poisoned world after a global war, a princess of the last valley fights to restore the bond between humanity and the earth.

name: Kiki's Delivery Service
overview: A young witch moves to a seaside town for her year of independence and starts a flying courier service — and loses her magic along the way.

name: Perfect Blue
overview: A pop idol reinvents herself as an actress while the people around her are murdered, and her grip on what is real starts to dissolve.
